description_en: Creates a load balancer instance that supports custom routing policies, session persistence, monitoring configurations, and other advanced features
description_zh: 用于创建一个新的负载均衡器实例，支持自定义路由策略、会话保持、监控配置等高级功能

name: CreateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en: The name of the load balancer. The name must be in a valid domain name format and must be a subdomain of the site
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器名称，需要满足域名格式校验，并且是站点下的子域名
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the load balancer is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡器是否启用。

true：启用。
false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-origin address pool failover. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否跨源地址池回源。

true：是。
false: 否
fields.name: failover_across_pools

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to retry the next IP address when back-to-origin fails and the origin server is a domain name that resolves to multiple IP addresses
fields.help_zh: 回源失败时，若源服务器是域名且解析出多个IP，则重试下一个IP
fields.name: origin_level_retry

parameters.help_en: The cross-origin address pool back-to-origin configuration
parameters.name: adaptive_routing

parameters.help_en: The list of default address pool IDs
parameters.name: default_pools

parameters.help_en: The fallback address pool ID. Traffic is directed to this pool when all other pools are unavailable
parameters.help_zh: 兜底地址池ID，当所有其他池不可用时，流量将被导向此处
parameters.name: fallback_pool

fields.help_en: The default round-robin weight applied to all address pools that do not have an individually specified weight. Valid values: integers from 0 to 100
fields.help_zh: 默认的轮询权重，用于所有没有单独指定权重的地址池。取值范围：0-100之间的整数
fields.name: default_weight

fields.help_en: The weight configuration for each backend server pool. The key is the pool ID and the value is the weight coefficient. The weight coefficient represents the relative proportion of traffic distribution
fields.help_zh: 各后端服务器池的权重配置，键为池ID，值为权重系数。权重系数表示相对流量分配的比例
fields.name: pool_weights

parameters.help_en: The weighted round-robin configuration that controls the traffic distribution weight across different address pools
parameters.help_zh: 加权轮询配置，用于控制不同地址池的流量分配权重
parameters.name: random_steering

fields.help_en: The Content-Type field in the HTTP header
fields.help_zh: HTTP Header中的Content-Type字段
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The location field in the HTTP response
fields.help_zh: HTTP 返回中的location字段
fields.name: location

fields.help_en: The response body value
fields.help_zh: 响应body值
fields.name: message_body

fields.help_en: The response status code
fields.help_zh: 响应状态码
fields.name: status_code

fields.help_en: The fixed response content returned after a rule is matched
fields.help_zh: 匹配规则后执行响应指定内容
fields.name: fixed_response

fields.help_en: The load balancing configuration that overwrites the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration when a rule is matched. The specified fields overwrite the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration
fields.help_zh: 匹配规则后修改对应请求改写的负载均衡配置，配置的字段，会覆盖负载均衡器配置里相应的字段
fields.name: overrides

fields.example: (http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.version eq "HTTP/1.0") or (ip.geoip.country eq "CN") or (http.host eq "www.example.com")
fields.help_en:
The rule content that uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
fields.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
fields.name: rule

fields.help_en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
fields.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
fields.name: rule_enable

fields.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
fields.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
fields.name: rule_name

fields.help_en: The rule execution order. This parameter is optional. If not specified, rules are executed in list order. If specified, the value must be a positive integer. A larger value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，可以不填，不填时以列表顺序执行，如果填的话，是大于0的整数。数值越大越优先执行
fields.name: sequence

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to stop executing subsequent rules. Valid values:

true: Stop executing subsequent rules.
false: Continue executing subsequent rules. This is the default value
fields.help_zh:
是否终止执行后续规则。

true：是。
false：否，默认值
fields.name: terminates

parameters.help_en:
The session persistence mode. Valid values:
off: disabled.
ip: IP-based session persistence.
cookie: cookie-based session persistence.
http_header: HTTP header-based session persistence
parameters.help_zh:
会话保持。取值范围：
off：不开启。
ip：按ip方式会话保持。
cookie: 按cookie方式会话保持。
http_header：按http header方式会话保持
parameters.name: session_affinity

parameters.help_en:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

geo: geo-based routing.
random: weighted round-robin.
order: primary/secondary mode
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡策略。

geo: 地址策略。
random: 加权轮询。
order: 主备方式
parameters.name: steering_policy

parameters.help_en: The description of the load balancer for management and identification purposes
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器的详细描述信息，便于管理和识别
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The TTL value, which specifies the time-to-live of the DNS record. Default value: 30 seconds. Valid values: 10 to 600
parameters.help_zh: TTL值，DNS记录的生存时间，默认为30秒。取值范围：10-600
parameters.name: ttl

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive failed probes required to consider the check failed, such as `5`
fields.help_zh: 连续探测多少次失败算失败，如`5`
fields.name: consecutive_down

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive successful probes required to consider the check successful, such as `3`
fields.help_zh: 连续探测多少次成功算成功，如`3`
fields.name: consecutive_up

fields.help_en: The expected status codes, such as `200,202`. These are the HTTP response codes that indicate success
fields.help_zh: 预期状态码，如`200,202`，成功的HTTP响应
fields.name: expected_codes

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to follow redirects. Valid values:

true: Follow redirects.
false: Do not follow redirects
fields.help_zh:
是否跟随重定向。

true：是。
false：否
fields.name: follow_redirects

fields.help_en: The header information included in the probe request. This is the HTTP header
fields.help_zh: 探测时所带头部信息，HTTP头
fields.name: header

fields.help_en: The monitoring interval in seconds, such as `60`. This specifies the check frequency
fields.help_zh: 监视间隔，如`60`秒，检查频率
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The monitor request method, such as `GET`. This is the HTTP method used for health checks
fields.help_zh: 监视器请求方法，如`GET`，HTTP协议中的方法
fields.name: method

fields.help_en:
The region where the probe nodes are located. Default value: Global. Valid values:

Global: worldwide.
ChineseMainland: the Chinese mainland.
OutsideChineseMainland: worldwide (excluding the Chinese mainland)
fields.help_zh:
探测点所在区域，默认为Global，

Global: 全球。
ChineseMainland: 中国内地。
OutsideChineseMainland: 全球（不包括中国内地）
fields.name: monitoring_region

fields.help_en: The monitor check path, such as `/healthcheck`. This is the URI of the request
fields.help_zh: 监视器检查路径，如`/healthcheck`，HTTP请求路径
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The origin server port
fields.help_zh: 源站端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The health check timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh: 应用健康检查超时时间，单位为秒，取值范围：1-10
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en:
The monitor protocol type used for health checks. A value of off indicates that health checks are disabled. Valid values:

TCP
UDP
SMTP
HTTPS
HTTP
ICMP Ping
off
fields.help_zh:
监视器协议类型，如HTTP，用于健康检查，值为off时，表示不进行检查。

TCP
UDP
SMTP
HTTPS
HTTP
ICMP Ping
off
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The monitor configuration for health checks
parameters.help_zh: 监视器配置，用于健康检查
parameters.name: monitor

parameters.help_en: The address pools mapped to secondary regions. If multiple secondary regions share the same set of address pools, you can concatenate the secondary region names with commas as the key
parameters.help_zh: 二级region对应的地址池，多个二级region共用一批地址池时，可以多个二级region，使用逗号拼接作为key
parameters.name: sub_region_pools

parameters.help_en: The address pools mapped to primary regions
parameters.name: region_pools
